items.title: UK court denies bail to lawyer Vijay Aggarwal’s aide in sexual assault case
items.summary: A London court on Friday rejected the bail application of Manpreet Kaur, an aide to Delhi-based criminal lawyer Vijay Aggarwal, who is facing four charges of sexual assault involving two women in the United Kingdom (UK). Kaur’s bail application was heard by Judge M Weekes at Southwark Crown Court on September 4. Kaur will remain in custody. The Court also imposed reporting restrictions on the proceedings. As a result, details of the bail hearing, including the reasons for rejecting the application, cannot be reported at present. Kaur, who is reportedly Aggarwal’s personal assistant, has been charged with two counts of intentionally encouraging or assisting the commission of sexual assault offences by him. The two Indian nationals were arrested on August 11 at a serviced townhouse on Brick Street in Mayfair, where they were reportedly staying. The arrests followed complaints of sexual assault at the property. Three of the charges against Aggarwal concern alleged incidents involving a woman on August 9.
